target_profile.system_boundary: Captured HashiCorp Raft library: main role loop, per-peer replication/heartbeat workers, FSM worker, snapshot worker and caller-supplied stores/transport/FSM. No deployment-specific application or crash-durable backend has been executed.
ownership: Replication workers own peer progress with shared locked commitment
FSM worker serializes application and restore
selection_injection: Caller supplies transport, stores, FSM and validated configuration; in-repository transport/storage implementations are not presumed externalized.
unknowns: No deployment authentication or fault model has been established.
No separately accessible guide.md was found in the authorized source/support trees; the supplied method and JSON schemas define this submission.

activities.realization_summary: Apply, appendEntries, replicateTo, commitment.match/recalculate; voter match aggregation and startIndex condition.
Follower timeout, optional prevote, durable election, role lifecycle, VerifyLeader and transfer.
InstallSnapshot and snapshot transfer repair missing history; explicit disaster recovery replaces state under a distinct contract.
Latest/committed configurations, voter suffrage, serialized changes and rollback on log truncation.
processLogs and runFSM separate commit/enqueue from callback and future completion.
LogStore/StableStore, startup replay and snapshots; concrete backend durability remains open.
Apply/Future, VerifyLeader, Barrier and recovery APIs expose distinct completion meanings.

behaviors.protocol_context: One ApplyFuture before and after term/index assignment
behaviors.trigger: Apply/ApplyLog sends a LogCommand to applyCh
external_effects: Returns a future; future creation or enqueue is not application completion.
important_branches: Enqueue timeout and shutdown are admission errors; follower/candidate rejects with ErrNotLeader; transfer blocks new leader writes. ErrLeadershipLost does not establish whether a write survived.
async_boundaries: applyCh to main loop; future response to caller

behaviors.protocol_context: Current term, newly assigned contiguous indexes, current leader commitment object
behaviors.trigger: Leader accepts an apply batch or its initial no-op
writes: Assign index and term; enqueue inflight future; update last-log metadata after StoreLogs succeeds.
durable_effects: Calls LogStore.StoreLogs before reporting local match.
important_branches: StoreLogs error responds with error and sets Follower; no successful local match on that branch.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Local storage completion contributes one ServerID match to voter-filtered commitment.

behaviors.execution_owner: Receiver main loop; optional transport heartbeat callback
behaviors.protocol_context: AppendEntries request term, previous index/term, entry suffix and leader commit bound
implementation_guards: Reject older term; advance term and normally become follower on valid newer/equal-term append context.
Check previous index/term when nonzero; skip same-term duplicates and delete conflicting suffix before appending.
writes: Update last log and configuration after successful storage; advance local commit to min(LeaderCommitIndex,lastIndex); enqueue unapplied entries.
durable_effects: StoreLogs of new suffix before Success=true.
important_branches: An empty heartbeat can succeed with no prefix check or log storage and no leader commit propagation.
Missing previous log, term mismatch, storage or configuration errors do not produce Success=true.
Conflicting suffix can roll latest configuration back to committed configuration.
async_boundaries: rpc.Respond delivers a response, not leader-side consumption.
FSM work queued via processLogs can remain pending when reply is emitted.
existing_protections: Stale terms rejected; prefix guard on data replication.
unknowns: Transport-specific concurrent fast heartbeat scheduling is not yet analyzed.

behaviors.execution_owner: Per-peer replication worker and pipeline decoder
behaviors.protocol_context: Captured leadership term, peer identity and commitment pointer
behaviors.trigger: AppendEntries response associated with a sent request
implementation_guards: Ordinary RPC error prevents match; higher response term signals stepDown; Success required for updateLastAppended.
Only nonempty request entries contribute a match index.
writes: Advance nextIndex and match last request entry; notify pending verification futures true.
important_branches: Rejection backs nextIndex down and retries with backoff controls; missing log sends snapshot; pipeline failure returns to ordinary replication.
Higher response term calls notifyAll(false) and signals the captured leadership stepDown channel.
async_boundaries: Per-peer request/reply transport and pipeline Consumer; captured commitment object is shared under its lock.
existing_protections: Old workers retain the old commitment and stepDown channel; later leadership gets new objects.
unknowns: Pipeline transport error-to-response correspondence needs a transport-specific review.

behaviors.execution_owner: commitment mutex and leader main loop
behaviors.protocol_context: ServerID match map for latest voters and first index of this leadership term
behaviors.trigger: Local or remote match update; configuration change; commit notification
implementation_guards: match ignores nonvoter IDs and nonincreasing indexes.
Sorted matches select majority position; commit must increase and reach startIndex.
writes: Advance commitment.commitIndex then notify main loop; main loop records commitIndex, committed configuration and removes committed inflight entries after processLogs.
important_branches: Latest configuration replacement retains matches by ID for remaining voters, initializes new voters at zero.
Committing removal of the local voter causes shutdown or follower transition.
existing_protections: Mutex serialization; current-term startIndex; voting eligibility filter.

behaviors.execution_owner: Main loop queues; runFSM owns client FSM calls
behaviors.protocol_context: Committed log index/order and original logFuture identity
behaviors.trigger: processLogs walks unapplied prefix and submits commit tuples
writes: Main lastApplied records enqueue progress; FSM lastIndex/lastTerm record processing progress.
external_effects: Call FSM.Apply or ApplyBatch; populate original future response and respond nil after the call.
important_branches: No-op is not sent to FSM; barrier is handled in FSM ordering but not passed to ApplyBatch.
ConfigurationStore is optional; batch response length mismatch panics; shutdown can abort enqueue.
async_boundaries: fsmMutateCh separates commitment/enqueue from FSM execution.
existing_protections: Ordered prefix traversal and duplicate application index guard.
unknowns: No application-specific FSM supplied or inspected; deterministic FSM behavior is an external interface obligation.

behaviors.execution_owner: Main candidate loop and one vote RPC worker per configured voter
behaviors.protocol_context: Election attempt channel, requested term, latest configuration
behaviors.trigger: Follower contact timeout or TimeoutNow; optional prevote then election
implementation_guards: Follower campaign requires voting membership; election requests go only to latest voters.
ElectSelf increments/persists term and persists own vote; main loop requires voter-majority grants and steps down on higher term.
external_effects: Set local role Leader and leader identity after tally.
important_branches: Pre-vote does not persist term/vote; unsupported pre-vote RPC may count as a pre-vote grant but still requires real election.
Election retry creates a new response channel; responses to a previous attempt cannot be tallied through the new channel.
Candidate rejects Apply and VerifyLeader.
existing_protections: Attempt-local response channels; separate pre-vote and real vote.

behaviors.protocol_context: Candidate encoded address/ID, requested term, persisted last vote and last log
implementation_guards: Reject known other leader unless transfer flag; reject missing membership or nonvoter candidate when ID is supplied.
Reject old terms and less up-to-date last log; duplicate same-term votes require same candidate bytes.
durable_effects: Persist vote term then candidate bytes before grant; persist current term before in-memory update.
important_branches: Higher-term eligible requests can force follower transition before final vote decision.
Legacy requests without ID skip membership checks; storage read/write errors deny grant.
unknowns: Crash/error behavior between separate stable-store writes is not established by the interface or exercised here.

behaviors.execution_owner: Main leader loop and replication workers
behaviors.protocol_context: One leadership period and its owned channels/commitment/inflight futures
behaviors.trigger: Entry to leader, higher-term RPC/reply, lease failure, removal or shutdown
writes: Allocate fresh commitment with startIndex=lastIndex+1; dispatch no-op; start replication to every other latest member.
On exit close peer stop channels, fail remaining inflight and verification futures with ErrLeadershipLost, clear leader state.
important_branches: Leader lease counts recent contact only from voters; contact need not be a successful append.
Higher-term replication response signals step-down; heartbeat uses a different response path.

cross_activity_effects.A1: New startIndex requires current-term support before old log prefix can be newly committed.
cross_activity_effects.A7: Outstanding public futures can return ambiguous leadership-loss errors; already queued FSM work is not revoked.

existing_protections: New leadership does not reuse prior match tallies; stored log entries survive for later reconfirmation.

behaviors.protocol_context: Latest and committed configuration with log indexes
behaviors.trigger: Public configuration change or received/replayed configuration log
implementation_guards: Leader accepts changes only with latest=committed and current-term entry committed; optional prevIndex must match current latest index.
writes: Validate unique IDs/addresses and at least one voter; append new configuration and activate it as latest.
Replace commitment voting set; start/stop replication for all members; rollback latest when truncating its suffix.
important_branches: AddVoter directly creates Voter in current code; no staging catch-up phase in this path.
Nonvoters are replicated to but excluded from commitment, election request set and lease tally.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Changes which match indexes qualify for advancement.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Changes campaign and vote eligibility; committing local removal ends authority.

unknowns: Live role/address change effects on already pending verification futures remain a separate question.

behaviors.execution_owner: BootstrapCluster and NewRaft before workers start
behaviors.protocol_context: Stored current term, snapshot metadata and suffix logs
writes: Initialize follower; load current term and last log; restore latest usable snapshot, then scan suffix for configurations.
durable_effects: Bootstrap requires clean state, persists term 1 and configuration entry 1.
important_branches: Snapshot failure falls back to older snapshots; failure of every available snapshot rejects startup.
NoSnapshotRestoreOnStart skips FSM restore while restoring metadata.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Persisted log/snapshot prefix remains available for later replication and commitment reconstruction.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Persisted term and vote keys constrain subsequent elections; startup does not claim leadership.

unknowns: Concrete storage backend crash guarantees and external FSM startup restoration are not validated.

behaviors.execution_owner: Leader replication worker, receiver main loop, receiver FSM worker
behaviors.trigger: Missing log triggers snapshot transfer; InstallSnapshot processing
implementation_guards: Reject old request term or invalid snapshot version; require complete byte count, successful sink close and FSM restoration.
Sender rejects higher response term before updating match; requires Success.
writes: Receiver records restored lastApplied/snapshot/configurations and compacts or removes old logs; sender advances nextIndex and reports snapshot index match.
external_effects: Successful sender processing notifies pending verification futures true.
important_branches: Transfer/storage/restore errors prevent successful acknowledgement; compaction errors are logged after successful restore.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Snapshot success contributes the snapshot index to voter-filtered commitment.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Restored configuration and snapshot log term affect subsequent eligibility and election freshness.

unknowns: Delayed snapshot installation relative to newer committed state needs its own legal-history investigation.

behaviors.execution_owner: Snapshot worker with FSM and main-loop requests
behaviors.protocol_context: FSM snapshot index/term and committed configuration index
implementation_guards: Reject when FSM snapshot index precedes committed configuration index.
durable_effects: Persist and close snapshot before recording snapshot metadata and compacting logs.

cross_activity_effects.A3: Provides snapshot producer for resynchronization and startup.
cross_activity_effects.A1: Preserves application prefix plus committed membership metadata after log compaction.

behaviors.execution_owner: Leader main loop, transfer goroutine, target TimeoutNow handler
behaviors.protocol_context: Selected peer replication progress and transfer lifetime
writes: Block new apply/config/restore while transfer is in progress; await replication nextIndex beyond lastIndex then send TimeoutNow.
Target becomes candidate with transfer flag, bypasses prevote; flag cleared at candidate-loop exit.
important_branches: Automatic target selection filters voters; explicit target requires replication state.
Transfer timeout or leader-loop exit controls future completion; a sent TimeoutNow alone is not evidence of election success.
existing_protections: Actual election still tallies voters and validates log freshness.

behaviors.execution_owner: Leader loop and FSM worker; offline RecoverCluster caller
behaviors.protocol_context: Explicit disaster-recovery operation, not normal commit history
writes: Online restore aborts inflight logs, creates snapshot at larger index in current term/current configuration, restores FSM, then public API submits a no-op and waits.
Offline RecoverCluster replays stored command suffix, snapshots supplied configuration, deletes old log range.
important_branches: Online restore rejects outstanding configuration change; public API warns this is for disaster recovery into a fresh cluster.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Exceptional restore can replace state outside ordinary command commitment; must be explicitly excluded or modeled in an ordinary safety check.

behaviors.execution_owner: Independent heartbeat goroutine per replication worker
behaviors.protocol_context: Worker-captured term and peer; map of pending verification futures
writes: On error-free transport return update lastContact and call notifyAll(resp.Success).
important_branches: Transport errors back off; stop channel ends worker.
Unlike ordinary replication this branch does not compare resp.Term to req.Term.
Heartbeat contains no log prefix or leader commit index.
existing_protections: Receiver rejects stale-term heartbeat; false success flag becomes negative verification notification.
unknowns: A positive reply may have been produced before future registration; no operation ID appears in the RPC.

behaviors.protocol_context: One verifyFuture, quorum from latest voter count
writes: Initialize votes=1 and voter-derived quorum; register future in every replication worker notify map; force heartbeats.
important_branches: Single-voter quorum completes immediately.
Registration loop has no suffrage filter; replState includes nonvoters.
unknowns: Whether nonvoter support can suffice for externally successful verification during loss of voter contact is the selected discriminator.

behaviors.execution_owner: Replication, snapshot or heartbeat goroutine; verifyFuture vote lock
behaviors.protocol_context: Pending future pointer in one peer notify map
writes: Swap out the peer notify map under lock; for each registered future call vote(bool).
Positive increments votes; threshold enqueues future to main loop and clears notifyCh; negative also enqueues and clears.
important_branches: Vote receives only bool, no peer ID, suffrage, response term or originating RPC identity.
Once notifyCh is nil subsequent vote calls do not change the tally.
existing_protections: Per-peer map clearing and future vote lock prevent repeated votes through the same drained registration.
unknowns: Interaction with concurrent registrations/removal deserves a separate scope from fixed membership.

behaviors.protocol_context: Same verifyFuture pointer and retained threshold
external_effects: At threshold respond nil; below threshold step down and return ErrNotLeader; remove future from leader and peer maps.
important_branches: Leader exit fails pending futures with ErrLeadershipLost; follower/candidate returns ErrNotLeader.

cross_activity_effects.A7: Public completion is used by callers to decide whether local reads may be stale, per API documentation.

facts.meaning: The leader recorded this server as matching through index i after local storage success, successful nonempty append response, or successful snapshot response.
facts.validity_context: Eligible to advance only if ID is in commitment.matchIndexes; support tied to a leadership object, not globally reusable.
facts.durability: Recorded matches are volatile; backing log/snapshot persistence relies on supplied stores.
facts.recovery: Re-established by executing the producing path in a new context.
unknowns: Storage backend crash behavior remains outside this map.

facts.meaning: The receiver completed the checks and writes applicable to this AppendEntries request and set Success=true; an empty heartbeat establishes no replicated log prefix.
facts.validity_context: Meaning depends on presence of PrevLogEntry and Entries; response delivery and consumption occur later.
facts.durability: Volatile observation; no separate durability claim.
facts.recovery: Re-established by executing the producing path in a new context.
unknowns: No transport-level message identity or Byzantine authenticity guarantee inferred.

facts.meaning: For this leadership commitment object the voter majority match position advanced to i at or beyond startIndex, and main loop consumes that bound for prefix processing.
facts.validity_context: Current configured voter map; previously committed prefix is carried by logs/snapshot, not old worker counters.
facts.durability: Commit counter is volatile; replicated log and snapshot are the durable backing.
facts.recovery: New leader reconfirms through a current-term entry; followers consume leader commit bound.
unknowns: Follower receipt of a bound is not an independent reconstruction of its quorum proof.

facts.meaning: The FSM callback for a committed command has returned and the matching ApplyFuture response has been populated before success notification.
facts.validity_context: Normal Apply path; excludes disaster recovery replacement.
facts.durability: FSM durability depends on caller implementation; future completion itself is volatile.
facts.recovery: Re-established by executing the producing path in a new context.
unknowns: The library exposes completion through Future.Error and ApplyFuture.Response, but the downstream application caller consuming this completed result is not mapped in the captured library. No client read, retry, or durable application consequence is established here.

facts.meaning: A voter grant for requested term and candidate has been returned after persisted vote checks/writes, or the candidate has persisted its self-vote.
facts.validity_context: Real election, separate from pre-vote; candidate IDs additionally checked on modern requests.
facts.durability: Term and candidate are separate stable-store writes; atomicity across them is not asserted.
facts.recovery: RequestVote consults persisted keys on later requests.
unknowns: Partial stable-store failure/crash between writes is not modeled.

facts.meaning: The local candidate received enough granted real-election results on its attempt channel to enter Leader state.
facts.validity_context: Local role acquisition; does not itself assert continuing external authority after a partition.
facts.durability: Volatile observation; no separate durability claim.
facts.recovery: Re-established by executing the producing path in a new context.

facts.meaning: A replication worker dispatched a positive verification notification because an error-free heartbeat response had Success=true, or a successful append/snapshot path called notifyAll(true). This is not itself a voter-qualified or operation-fresh quorum assertion.

identity.context: captured leadership term and pending notify-map contents

facts.validity_context: Notification targets futures present when notifyAll drains its map; positive carries no responder suffrage, RPC identity or production time to vote().
facts.durability: Volatile observation; no separate durability claim.
facts.recovery: Re-established by executing the producing path in a new context.
unknowns: Same-history correlation of request production, reply delivery and future registration has not been executed.

facts.meaning: The future has accumulated its numeric quorum threshold of positive votes (including initialized self vote) and was enqueued for completion.
facts.validity_context: A threshold result is distinct from a negative wake-up on the same channel; both are checked by leaderLoop.
facts.durability: Volatile observation; no separate durability claim.

unknowns: Threshold does not encode the identities or suffrage of contributing peers.

surfaces.reason: Selected next discriminator: voter-count threshold is fed by registrations on all replication peers. Need applicable contract and actual same-history completion before asserting a defect.

Heartbeat updates contact and forwards Success without the higher-term guard used by data replication. Lease checks and negative verify notifications are contrary protections; consequences require a controlled actual history.
Snapshot restore changes application progress and membership; ordering relative to a newer committed prefix has not been checked. Requires a legal producer history and snapshot endpoint.

surfaces.entry_point: NetworkTransport fast heartbeat and pipeline implementations
surfaces.reason: Transport interface admits a callback concurrent with blocking work; concrete implementation must be read before attributing synchronization guarantees.
Vote persistence uses two writes; interface does not state cross-key transactionality. A specific backend and permitted crash/error model are needed.

formation.explanation: Apply creates a future and queues a command. Only the leader dispatches it, assigns term/index, calls StoreLogs and reports its own match. Per-peer workers send predecessor-qualified appends; followers reject stale terms or mismatching prefixes, truncate conflicting suffixes and store new entries before success. Ordinary and pipeline consumers use the corresponding request to report the last appended index; snapshot completion is an alternate support producer. commitment filters ServerIDs to latest voters, takes the majority match position and requires reaching the first index of this term. The main loop records commitment, processes the prefix and sends commit tuples to the FSM worker. runFSM completes command futures after callbacks. Later appends carry the commit bound to followers. Empty heartbeat success establishes contact without a replicated prefix. Store errors, retry/backoff, higher terms and shutdown take distinct paths.

context.explanation: Bootstrap persists initial term/configuration; NewRaft restores term, snapshot and configuration suffix before starting follower/FSM/snapshot workers. A voting follower with expired contact becomes candidate, optionally prevotes, then electSelf persists the new term and own vote and contacts latest voters. Vote handlers check leader, membership, term, prior vote and log freshness; majority grants on an attempt-local channel establish the local Leader role. Entry allocates new commitment/replication state and appends a no-op. Higher-term RPCs, higher-term data replies, loss of voter contact and committed removal can end leadership; cleanup stops replication and fails remaining inflight/verify futures. Transfer pauses writes, catches up a selected peer, sends TimeoutNow and still requires a real election. Verification is an additional public authority check based on asynchronous peer notifications, not the commit counter.

connection.explanation: Stored log/snapshot history survives leadership loss, but match tallies and response channels do not transfer into the next leader object. New authority uses log freshness in elections and a current-term startIndex/no-op to reconfirm advancement over old entries. Old replication workers retain old commitment/stepDown pointers; old election replies remain on old attempt channels. Remaining inflight calls fail on exit, whereas already queued committed FSM work may finish. Membership affects elections, commitment and leases via latest voter eligibility; configuration changes require stable prior membership and a current-term commit, and truncation can roll latest back. Snapshots bind an applied prefix to committed membership and reconstruct it at startup or resynchronization. Disaster recovery is explicitly exceptional and not interchangeable with normal Apply. VerifyLeader consumes response notifications through a separate boolean tally; its voter-eligibility and freshness meaning must be investigated rather than borrowed from commitment.

open_details: Concrete transport pipeline error propagation and optional concurrent fast-heartbeat path.
Crash atomicity/durability and storage failure recovery variants.
Live membership mutation during pending verification.
Delayed snapshot ordering against newer committed state.
Historical membership.md is a proposal: its staging AddVoter and committed GetConfiguration descriptions differ from current code; use current interface/code for applicability.
core_overview.rationale: Both core paths and the connecting ownership, eligibility, persistence, old-work and completion mechanisms have been traced through actual callers and consumers. Usable means sufficient source backbone to select a local discriminator; no execution, broad safety conclusion or complete coverage is asserted.
